correctness.rationale: O'Brien--Voll reduces degree-q^i character counts to rank-2i specializations with factor q^(n-2i). On every support without an even cycle, Wang--Zhou rank rigidity gives rank twice the matching number. For an even cycle, the only deviation occurs on full support where the two Pfaffian monomials cancel; exactly (q-1)^(2r-1) points then have rank 2r-2 rather than 2r.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Rossmann 2022 poses the character-count question and lists only edgeless graphs, paths, and complete graphs as polynomial cases. Searches found no prior graphical-group character formula for all even-cycle-free graphs or all cycles; Wang--Zhou 2014 supplies only the skew-rank ingredient, while Qiao 2024 and Rossmann--Voll 2025 address different enumeration problems.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an explicit combinatorial character-degree formula for an infinite structural class of graphical groups and extends the answer to every cycle, with a precise Pfaffian-cancellation correction for even cycles.
